results.title: Mysterious Warrior
results.overview: Unearthed by James Balsamo That necromancer of the lens, that goblin king of gore comes a celluloid chimera so fried, so freaky, so fantastically confused, it can only be called Junior Webb's MYSTERIOUS WARRIOR. Behold: a CGI crab monster with a bad attitude, cardboard robot beatdowns in parking lot arenas, and southern-fried Kung Fu kicks that echo across the astral plane! This is a forgotten fever dream of fists, fireballs, and forbidden frocks a cinematic relic forged in the crusty crucible of camcorders, caffeine, and chaos.

results.title: Homo Argentum
results.overview: The film consists of 16 shorts that explore, with humor and social criticism, the characteristics of the Argentine identity.

results.title: Fuori
results.overview: Rome. The 1980s. After the magnum opus The Art of Joy she has been working on for a decade is rejected by the Italian publishing world, writer Goliarda Sapienza commits a desperate theft that costs her her reputation and social position. Incarcerated in Italy’s largest female prison, she finds herself living alongside thieves, junkies, sex workers and revolutionaries. After her release, she continues to meet with these women and over the course of a sweltering summer, a life-changing relationship flowers – a relationship that will reawaken her the desire to live and to write.

results.title: INERTIA

results.title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
results.original_title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
results.overview: Emmy-winning actor, writer, and comedian Brett Goldstein brings his irresistible charm and quick wit stateside for his first HBO stand-up special. Best known for the hit shows "Ted Lasso" and "Shrinking", Goldstein sheds his testy Roy Kent façade to share his hilarious insights on love, sex, masculinity, "Sesame Street", and everything in between.

results.title: Graduation Trip: Mallorca
results.original_title: Viaje de fin de curso: Mallorca
results.overview: 2021. After spending a year in confinement, a group of high school students and their two teachers begin an end-of-year trip to Mallorca. This great plan is the last opportunity they have to all be together, make up for lost time, be able to have fun like they have never had before and say goodbye to this crazy stage of their lives. However, a new coronavirus outbreak disrupts all their plans and forces them to stay locked in their hotel rooms. More than 50 students, 2 teachers, a hotel and many, many minibars... What could go wrong?

results.title: One to One: John & Yoko
results.overview: An exploration of the seminal and transformative 18 months that one of music’s most famous couples — John Lennon and Yoko Ono — spent living in Greenwich Village, New York City, in the early 1970s.
